input.command:
git add src/worker/routes/plugins.ts src/worker/env.ts src/worker/containers.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(deploy-cloudflare): implement GET /api/plugins/examples and POST /api/plugins/install

- GET /api/plugins/examples: return static bundled catalogue with localPath set
  to the npm package name (CF has no local filesystem; UI uses localPath as the
  install identifier so npm installs work transparently)
- POST /api/plugins/install: proxy to sidecar (needs npm + filesystem access);
  routes via SIDECAR_SERVICE DO when available, SIDECAR_URL env var otherwise
- Add proxySidecar() helper shared by future sidecar-delegated endpoints
- Restore SIDECAR_URL / SIDECAR_API_KEY to Env (needed by proxySidecar and
  SidecarContainer fallback; set in .dev.vars for local dev)
- SidecarContainer: check SIDECAR_URL env var before KV SANDBOX_BRIDGE_URL
  so local dev (.dev.vars SIDECAR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3101) works correctly

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
input.description: Commit plugin examples and install routes
